questions.qtext: Which will be the equation of simplification of the given $K$-map?
questions.solution:
Answer: C

Source solution 1 (score: 0)

CORRECT ANSWER IS :- (C)

K-map (rows AB = 00,01,11,10; cols CD = 00,01,11,10) mein ones at m1(0001), m2(0010), m9(1001), m11(1011). Don’t-cares at m0(0000), m8(1000), m10(1010).

Badi group (A=1, B=0) → AB′AB'AB′ covers m8,m9,m10,m11 (uses don’t-cares to include m9,m11).

  • Remaining ones m1 and m2 can be covered by two 4-cell groups that use don’t-cares:

    • B′C′B'C'B′C′ (B=0,C=0) covers m0,m1,m8,m9 → gives m1,

    • B′D′B'D'B′D′ (B=0,D=0) covers m0,m2,m8,m10 → gives m2.

    • Combine: AB′+B′C′+B′D′AB' + B'C' + B'D'AB′+B′C′+B′D′ — same as option C

    • (order different: B′D′+AB′+B′C′B'D' + AB' + B'C'B′D′+AB′+B′C′).

questions.qtext:
Consider the following expression

$a\bar d + \bar a \bar c + b\bar cd$

Which of the following expressions does not correspond to the Karnaugh Map obtained for the given expression?

options.text: $\bar c \bar d+ a\bar d + ab\bar c + \bar a \bar cd$
$\bar a\bar c + \bar c\bar d + a\bar d + ab\bar cd$
$\bar a\bar c + a\bar d + ab\bar c + \bar cd$
$\bar b\bar c \bar d + ac\bar d + \bar a \bar c + ab\bar c$

questions.solution:
Answer: C

Source solution 1 (score: 0)

$ad'$ [fill minterm in K-map in front for $a$ and $d'$ ]

Similarly, fill all minterms for $ad'+a'c' +bc'd$, resulting K-map will be:

Option (a) $c'd'+ ad' + abc' + a'c'd$

is equivalent to given expression

Option (b) $a'c' + c'd' + ad' + abc'd$

is equivalent to given expression.

Option (c) $a'c' + ad' + abc' + c'd$

is not equivalent to given expression.

Option (d) $b'c'd' + acd' + a'c' + abc'$

is equivalent to given expression.

So, answer is C.

Source solution 2 (score: 0)
